name: Security Diff Scan
description: Review a patch or revision comparison for introduced security regressions and incomplete fixes.
author: Dyadic
abilities: Pins base and head revisions and reads complete diffs
Traces changed behavior through unchanged callers and controls
Separates introduced, worsened, incomplete-fix, and pre-existing issues
permissions: Does not post reviews or modify branches unless explicitly requested

changes.notes: Initial Dyadic-native security diff review workflow.
